skills.name: alphatrace-data-backfill
skills.description: Implement, inspect, or run AlphaTraceAI historical market-data backfills from existing Unusual Whales ZIP archives or Full Tape. Reuse the UW data-lake skill for Full Tape acquisition and conversion while keeping legacy dataset ingestion separate. Not for ordinary API lookups, trading advice, or unrelated AlphaTraceAI work.

interface.shortDescription: Integrate legacy UW archives and Full Tape history
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $alphatrace-data-backfill to implement or run the requested AlphaTraceAI backfill, selecting the correct archive format and preserving raw sources.

skills.name: unusual-whales-api
skills.description: Query Unusual Whales REST data for options flow, dark-pool prints, market tide, Greeks, fundamentals, and charts; use its official API examples without inventing routes or overstating data completeness. Use the specialized UW skills for 13F analysis, Full Tape lake builds, or earnings-volatility scans.

interface.shortDescription: Query UW data with verified routes and quota awareness

skills.name: uw-earnings-vol-scan
skills.description: Run or explain the Unusual Whales earnings-volatility scanner for long call calendar research, including IV/RV, term-structure filters, and report deadlines. Use for the named provider strategy; do not turn a scan label into a trade order or independently validated return forecast.

interface.shortDescription: Run the provider earnings-volatility research scanner

skills.name: uw-institutional
skills.description: Query and analyze institutional 13F filings, holdings, activity, ownership, CIKs, and tags through Unusual Whales; optionally maintain an explicitly requested local SQLite cache. Use for filing-based institutional analysis, not current broker positions or trade execution.

interface.shortDescription: Analyze institutional filings, CIKs, and holdings

skills.name: uw-options-data-lake
skills.description: Build or inspect a local Unusual Whales Full Tape options lake, convert archives to bronze Parquet, derive one-minute contract bars, and run the provider's example screen/forward analysis. Use for explicitly requested local tape workflows, not ordinary API lookups or automatic bulk downloads.

interface.shortDescription: Build and inspect local options tape and minute bars

skills.name: imagegen
skills.description: Generate or edit raster images when the task benefits from AI-created bitmap visuals such as photos, illustrations, textures, sprites, mockups, or transparent-background cutouts. Use when Codex should create a brand-new image, transform an existing image, or derive visual variants from references, and the output should be a bitmap asset rather than repo-native code or vector. Do not use when the task is better handled by editing existing SVG/vector/code-native assets, extending an established icon or logo system, or building the visual directly in HTML/CSS/canvas.

interface.shortDescription: Generate or edit images for websites, games, and more
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $imagegen to make or edit an image for this project.

skills.name: openai-docs
skills.description: Use for Codex models/pricing, scheduled tasks, skills, settings, setup, troubleshooting, customization, automations, and self-knowledge—including 'you,' 'your,' 'this app,' or 'this coding agent' when they refer to Codex—and for OpenAI APIs/products and ChatGPT Work. Also use for model choice/migration, prompting, SDKs, Responses, Realtime, agents, evals, and Chat/Work/Codex comparisons. Do not use for generic app/software tasks that merely mention Codex.
skills.shortDescription: Codex models/pricing, scheduled tasks, skills, settings, setup, troubleshooting, and self-knowledge; OpenAI APIs and ChatGPT Work. 'You'/'this app' means Codex only.

interface.shortDescription: OpenAI and Codex docs for models, skills, tasks, and setup
interface.defaultPrompt: Use OpenAI Docs for official docs lookup, questions about Codex itself or Codex surfaces, model selection, model migration, and prompt-upgrade work.

skills.name: plugin-creator
skills.description: Create and scaffold plugin directories for Codex with a required `.codex-plugin/plugin.json`, optional plugin folders/files, valid manifest defaults, and personal-marketplace entries by default. Use when Codex needs to create a new personal plugin, add optional plugin structure, generate or update marketplace entries for plugin ordering and availability metadata, or update an existing local plugin during development with the CLI-driven cachebuster and reinstall flow.

interface.defaultPrompt: Use $plugin-creator to scaffold a valid plugin in the personal marketplace, then validate it before handing it back.

skills.name: review-agent
skills.description: Perform a read-only, defect-first review of a specified code change and return every actionable finding. Use when another agent delegates review of uncommitted changes, a base-branch diff, a commit, or custom review instructions.

interface.shortDescription: Find actionable bugs in code changes
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $review-agent to review the requested code changes and return actionable findings.
